feature_policy.source: User decision at Phase 3 approval gate (2026-09-13)
feature_policy.exclusion_reason: Strict pre-call model: duration is post-call leakage; poutcome (prior success) and campaign (attempt count that may include the outcome call) excluded per user choice to avoid any decision-time leakage.

split.strategy_note: 70/15/15. Stratified split for classification (or time-based if a relevant temporal field is justified in Phase 4).

imbalance.mitigation: class_weight=balanced for LogisticRegression/DecisionTree/RandomForest; balanced sample_weight for GradientBoosting (see src/model/models.py)
imbalance.note: Minority/majority ratio 0.1127 < 0.5, so mitigation applies. Implemented in Phase 4 training code; this block documents the policy.

candidates.hyperparameter_policy: Fixed candidate-level hyperparameters (documented in model_report.md); selection happens across candidates on validation, not via a hyperparameter search.

feature_importance.local_explanations: shap (TreeExplainer for tree models, linear contributions for LogisticRegression)
